-- task: ads_channel_summary_d
-- doc: 渠道推广详情日汇总，三张 DWS 日表 FULL JOIN，对齐现网 ads.ads_channel_summary_d
-- params: DT, OUT_DB

-- 口径对齐 db/ads/ads.sql · job ads_channel_summary_d（海豚 wf_ads_日报表_日）
-- 只读日汇总：dws_app_channel_summary_d_d、dws_app_channel_retention_d_d、dws_register_by_landing_page_d_d
-- 不扫事件明细。只写 Paimon；SR 影子回写见 pb_ads_channel_summary_d.sql

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone = Asia/Shanghai;

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_channel_summary_d
PARTITION (dt = '${DT}') (
    app_id,
    channel,
    new_user,
    recharge_amount,
    landing_page_click_num,
    landing_page_new_user_num,
    install_num,
    ad_click_num,
    last_day_new_user_num,
    last_day_retention_num,
    last7_day_new_user_num,
    last7_day_retention_num
)
WITH t1 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_channel_summary_d_d
    WHERE date_key = DATE '${DT}'
),
t2 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_channel_retention_d_d
    WHERE date_key = DATE '${DT}'
),
t3 AS (
    SELECT app_id, channel, exposure_download_num
    FROM paimon.dws.dws_register_by_landing_page_d_d
    WHERE date_key = DATE '${DT}'
),
t4 AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(t1.app_id, t2.app_id) AS app_id,
        COALESCE(t1.channel, t2.channel) AS channel,
        COALESCE(t1.new_user, 0) AS new_user,
        COALESCE(t1.recharge_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS recharge_amount,
        COALESCE(t1.landing_page_click_num, 0) AS landing_page_click_num,
        COALESCE(t1.install_num, 0) AS install_num,
        COALESCE(t1.ad_click_num, 0) AS ad_click_num,
        COALESCE(t2.last_day_new_user_num, 0) AS last_day_new_user_num,
        COALESCE(t2.last_day_retention_num, 0) AS last_day_retention_num,
        COALESCE(t2.last7_day_new_user_num, 0) AS last7_day_new_user_num,
        COALESCE(t2.last7_day_retention_num, 0) AS last7_day_retention_num
    FROM t1
    FULL OUTER JOIN t2
        ON t1.app_id = t2.app_id AND t1.channel = t2.channel
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(t4.app_id, t3.app_id) AS app_id,
    COALESCE(t4.channel, t3.channel) AS channel,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.new_user, 0)) AS new_user,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.recharge_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18, 6)))) AS recharge_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.landing_page_click_num, 0)) AS landing_page_click_num,
    SUM(COALESCE(t3.exposure_download_num, 0)) AS landing_page_new_user_num,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.install_num, 0)) AS install_num,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.ad_click_num, 0)) AS ad_click_num,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.last_day_new_user_num, 0)) AS last_day_new_user_num,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.last_day_retention_num, 0)) AS last_day_retention_num,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.last7_day_new_user_num, 0)) AS last7_day_new_user_num,
    SUM(COALESCE(t4.last7_day_retention_num, 0)) AS last7_day_retention_num
FROM t4
FULL OUTER JOIN t3
    ON t4.app_id = t3.app_id AND t4.channel = t3.channel
GROUP BY
    COALESCE(t4.app_id, t3.app_id),
    COALESCE(t4.channel, t3.channel);

-- 渠道推广详情 Paimon。无 bitmap 列，与现网 ads.ads_channel_summary_d 指标一致。
-- OUT_DB 测试渲染 test，生产渲染 paimon。
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_channel_summary_d (
    app_id                       STRING,
    channel                      STRING,
    new_user                     BIGINT,
    recharge_amount              DECIMAL(18, 6),
    landing_page_click_num       BIGINT,
    landing_page_new_user_num    BIGINT,
    install_num                  BIGINT,
    ad_click_num                 BIGINT,
    last_day_new_user_num        BIGINT,
    last_day_retention_num       BIGINT,
    last7_day_new_user_num       BIGINT,
    last7_day_retention_num      BIGINT,
    dt                           STRING
)
USING paimon
PARTITIONED BY (dt);

-- 影子表。结构照现网 ads.ads_channel_summary_d，只改表名。
-- 正式表仍由海豚写入。
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ads`.`ads_channel_summary_d_paimon_shadow` (
  `date_key` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT "日期",
  `app_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT "应用id",
  `channel` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT "渠道码",
  `new_user` int(11) NULL COMMENT "注册用户人数",
  `recharge_amount` decimal(18, 6) NULL COMMENT "充值金额",
  `landing_page_click_num` int(11) NULL COMMENT "落地页点击数",
  `landing_page_new_user_num` int(11) NULL COMMENT "通过落地页点击注册用户数",
  `install_num` int(11) NULL COMMENT "安装数",
  `ad_click_num` int(11) NULL COMMENT "用户点击数",
  `last_day_new_user_num` int(11) NULL COMMENT "昨日新增用户数",
  `last_day_retention_num` int(11) NULL COMMENT "次日留存用户数",
  `last7_day_new_user_num` int(11) NULL COMMENT "7日前新增用户数",
  `last7_day_retention_num` int(11) NULL COMMENT "7日留存用户数"
) ENGINE=OLAP
PRIMARY KEY(`date_key`, `app_id`, `channel`)
COMMENT "渠道推广详情影子表，Spark 回写，不替代正式表"
PARTITION BY RANGE(`date_key`) (
    START ("2025-12-20") END ("2026-10-28") EVERY (INTERVAL 1 DAY)
)
DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(`app_id`, `channel`) BUCKETS 32
ORDER BY(`date_key`)
PROPERTIES (
  "compression" = "LZ4",
  "dynamic_partition.buckets" = "32",
  "dynamic_partition.enable" = "true",
  "dynamic_partition.end" = "3",
  "dynamic_partition.history_partition_num" = "30",
  "dynamic_partition.prefix" = "p",
  "dynamic_partition.start" = "-9999",
  "dynamic_partition.time_unit" = "DAY",
  "dynamic_partition.time_zone" = "Asia/Shanghai",
  "enable_persistent_index" = "true",
  "fast_schema_evolution" = "true",
  "replicated_storage" = "true",
  "replication_num" = "3"
);

-- task: pb_ads_channel_summary_d
-- doc: 渠道推广详情从 Paimon 回写 StarRocks 影子表
-- params: DT, DTC

SET new_planner_optimize_timeout = 60000;
-- 回写影子表。正式表仍由海豚写入。
INSERT OVERWRITE ads.ads_channel_summary_d_paimon_shadow PARTITION (p${DTC}) (
    date_key,
    app_id,
    channel,
    new_user,
    recharge_amount,
    landing_page_click_num,
    landing_page_new_user_num,
    install_num,
    ad_click_num,
    last_day_new_user_num,
    last_day_retention_num,
    last7_day_new_user_num,
    last7_day_retention_num
)
SELECT
    CAST(dt AS DATETIME),
    app_id,
    channel,
    CAST(new_user AS INT),
    CAST(recharge_amount AS DECIMAL(18, 6)),
    CAST(landing_page_click_num AS INT),
    CAST(landing_page_new_user_num AS INT),
    CAST(install_num AS INT),
    CAST(ad_click_num AS INT),
    CAST(last_day_new_user_num AS INT),
    CAST(last_day_retention_num AS INT),
    CAST(last7_day_new_user_num AS INT),
    CAST(last7_day_retention_num AS INT)
FROM paimon.ads.ads_channel_summary_d
WHERE dt = '${DT}';

task:
  name: ads_channel_summary_d
  workflow: ""
  project: dc-platform
  owner: 又初
  frequency: daily

params:
  - name: DT
    description: 业务日 yyyy-MM-dd
  - name: OUT_DB
    description: Paimon catalog（test 环境 test，生产 paimon）

outputs:
  - database: ads
    table: ads_channel_summary_d
    layer: ads
    table_name: ads_channel_summary_d
    etl:
      - ads_channel_summary_d_paimon_ddl.sql
      - ads_channel_summary_d.sql
  - database: ads
    table: ads_channel_summary_d_paimon_shadow
    layer: ads
    table_name: ads_channel_summary_d_paimon_shadow
    etl:
      - ads_channel_summary_d_ddl.sql
      - pb_ads_channel_summary_d.sql

upstream:
  - dws.dws_app_channel_summary_d_d
  - dws.dws_app_channel_retention_d_d
  - dws.dws_register_by_landing_page_d_d

downstream: []

checks:
  design: design.md
  spec: spec.md
